must_fix_used.claim_in_article: “Trump dropped his proposed fee for ships crossing Hormuz”
must_fix_used.issue: The summary describes the proposal as a fee for ships, while the Ledger specifies a proposed 20% reimbursement on all cargo passing through the strait and says the payer and collection design were not specified. The wording can imply a vessel-based charge.
must_fix_used.explanation: 対象を「通過する全貨物」から「通航する船舶」へ変えており、課金対象の範囲が変わるため changed_scope を true とした。
